reason: The soft wash needs a load-spreading surface; steel and cargo mesh look like plausible crossing materials.
expectation: They will form a reinforced surface for the rover to cross.

alternatives.reason: I could check which materials the crossing accepts first.

effect: The steel and mesh made stiffened traction panels, ready to place at the wash.
reaction: The load-spreading explanation makes the construction feel physically sensible.
reason: The framed panels are intended to support the rover across the soft crossing.
expectation: The panels will be laid across the soft ground to support the wheels.

effect: The panels now support the crossing, and the next goal is to get the rover across.
reaction: The distinction between supported panels and loose mesh makes the crossing more convincing.
reason: The winch can be secured to the sound rock to help the rover cross.
expectation: The winch will be anchored to the rock for the crossing.

effect: The winch is anchored and aligned for the crossing; the supported panels remain the route across.
reaction: The recovery setup gives the crossing a practical purpose.
reason: The anchored winch and supported panels are the prepared components for taking the rover across.
expectation: The rover will cross the supported panels using the anchored winch for assistance.

effect: The rover crossed successfully, and the supported route remains available for the return trip. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The controlled crossing was a satisfying payoff for preparing both the panels and the winch.

mostWorthwhile.text: Placing the traction panels was most worthwhile: the explanation distinguished supported, stiffened panels from loose mesh that would sink, making the engineering decision understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Anchoring the winch was a straightforward preparation rather than an especially interesting decision, though it had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The panels needed supported ground through the soft section, not just a stiff frame; that qualified my initial expectation of a simple load-spreading surface.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the panels, anchor and winch each had an explained role in the crossing.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see what the farther ice core reveals; the crossing was brief but its practical explanations made the expedition feel grounded.
